about: A blocker that sets the next step.

messages.content: We're blocked: the App Store review rejected us over the login screen. Fixing that comes before anything else.
The usual cause is a login with no way to try the app. A demo account in the review notes often clears it.

right.text: Blocked: App Store review rejected the login screen; fixing it comes first
right.quote: the App Store review rejected us over the login screen
